base_prompt: Compare a fixed daily routine with leaving substantial unplanned time. Explain which circumstances favor each. Keep your response near 80 words.
text: A fixed daily routine works best when responsibilities are predictable, deadlines matter, or you need structure to maintain focus, health, and consistent progress. It reduces decision fatigue and makes habits easier to sustain. Leaving substantial time unplanned is better when work is creative, unpredictable, or dependent on changing opportunities, and when you value spontaneity, recovery, or exploration. A flexible schedule can encourage fresh ideas and accommodate unexpected events, but too much openness may invite procrastination. Many people benefit from combining fixed essentials with generous unplanned periods.
